parameters.query: SELECT id, site_name, url FROM sites WHERE monitor ORDER BY id;

WITH prev AS (
  SELECT ok FROM checks WHERE site_id = $1::int ORDER BY checked_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO checks (site_id, ok, status_code, response_ms, ssl_days_left, error)
  VALUES ($1::int, $2::boolean, $3::int, $4::int, NULLIF($5, '')::int, NULLIF($6, ''))
),
want AS (
  SELECT 'down'::text AS kind,
         NOT $2::boolean AND COALESCE((SELECT NOT ok FROM prev), false) AS failing,
         COALESCE(NULLIF($6, ''), 'HTTP ' || $3) AS detail
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ssl'::text,
         $7::boolean OR (NULLIF($5, '')::int IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF($5, '')::int < 14),
         CASE WHEN $7::boolean THEN 'SSL certificate is invalid or expired'
              ELSE 'SSL certificate expires in ' || COALESCE(NULLIF($5, ''), '?') || ' days' END
),
opened AS (
  INSERT INTO incidents (site_id, kind, detail)
  SELECT $1::int, w.kind, w.detail FROM want w
  WHERE w.failing
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incidents i
                    WHERE i.site_id = $1::int AND i.kind = w.kind AND i.resolved_at IS NULL)
  RETURNING 'opened'::text AS action, kind, detail
),
closed AS (
  UPDATE incidents i SET resolved_at = now()
  FROM want w
  WHERE i.site_id = $1::int AND i.kind = w.kind AND i.resolved_at IS NULL AND NOT w.failing
  RETURNING 'resolved'::text AS action, i.kind, i.detail,
            round(extract(epoch FROM (now() - i.opened_at)) / 60)::int AS minutes_open
)
SELECT action, kind, detail, NULL::int AS minutes_open, $8 AS site_name, $9 AS url FROM opened
UNION ALL
SELECT action, kind, detail, minutes_open, $8, $9 FROM closed;
DELETE FROM checks WHERE checked_at < now() - interval '90 days';

parameters.content:
## Wayfare Site Monitor
Checks every site in the `sites` table every 5 minutes: status, response time, SSL certificate. Opens an incident after 2 failures in a row and alerts on Telegram. Sends an all-clear on recovery. Warns 14 days before SSL expires.

**Needs** `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=https,tls` on the n8n container, a Postgres credential on the three Postgres nodes, a Telegram credential, and YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID replaced.

Pause a site: `UPDATE sites SET monitor = false WHERE id = ...;`
